description: Converra fixes the behavior, not the code. It reads production conversations, diagnoses failures at the step they happened, generates a bounded prompt or configuration fix, tests it head-to-head against the current agent in simulation, ships what the customer approves, and reports a production verdict on every fix: verified, not fixed, or confounded.
rules: Converra fixes the behavior, not the code, with a production verdict on every fix.
Require customer approval before deployment and explicit authority for audits.
